mapper.select: select pd.images_url as imagesUrl, pd.id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, ps.sale_state as saleState, wh.name as warehouseName, case when inv.dict_inventory_status in ('usable','frozen') then sum(inv.qty) else 0 end as realQty, case when inv.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' then inv.qty else 0 end as useQty, case when inv.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' then inv.qty else 0 end as freezeQty, case when inv.dict_inventory_status = 'inTransit' then inv.qty else 0 end as inTransitQty from inventory inv left join product_detail pd on inv.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join product_sale ps on inv.sku_id = ps.sku_id and ps.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on inv.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false where inv.is_deleted = false group by inv.id
